name: Candy
verdict: Candy is the home-appliance brand of Haier Europe, part of Haier Smart Home.
note: Al-Khaleej partnership announced by Haier, 2025-11-25. ASPI's 2020 'Uyghurs for sale' report names Haier and Candy among 82 companies 'potentially directly or indirectly benefiting' from Xinjiang labour transfers in their supply chains (based on published supplier lists); that is journalism, not a human-rights finding against the company (same standard as the adidas re-rating, docs/rating-review-2026-09-27.md).
